comments: @unwovened can you post a redacted log of the http requests in debug mode of the locks/mine and the failing one?

I was able to replicate this by unpairing a connect from my lock. It will happen with any lock that doesn't have a paired connect because its missing "Bridge" in the lock detail.



With bridge
```
{
    "LockName": "<snip>",
    "currentFirmwareVersion": "<version>",
    "homeKitEnabled": true,
    "zWaveEnabled": false,
    "isGalileo": false,
    "Bridge": {
        "_id": "<snip>",
        "mfgBridgeID": "<snip>",
        "deviceModel": "august-connect",
        "firmwareVersion": "<version>",
        "operative": true,
        "status": {
            "current": "online",
            "updated": "TIME",
            "lastOnline": "TIME",
            "lastOffline": "TIME"
        },
        "hyperBridge": true
    },
    ...
}
```

The "Bridge" key is missing if there is no connect

To fix we would need to get_lock_detail during setup and only create devices which have "Bridge" in the json api result.   The underlying py-august (sorry @snjoetw more PRs to review) library needs to be updated to include this in the lock detail.

There is also a bug where we create door open/closed sensors when there is no sensor

Has sensor:
```
    "LockStatus": {
        "status": "locked",
        "dateTime": "TIME",
        "isLockStatusChanged": false,
        "valid": true,
        "doorState": "open"
    },
```

Does not have sensor:
```
    "LockStatus": {
        "status": "locked",
        "dateTime": "TIME",
        "isLockStatusChanged": false,
        "valid": true
    },
````

Work to fix this is here
https://github.com/bdraco/august/tree/handle_locks_without_bridges_or_doorsense

Will need some tests though before merge
